exposure: Combination of dinoprostone and oxytocin for labor induction
cohort: The study included 72 eligible women admitted for induction of labor between June 2019 and May 2020.
finding: Misoprostol alone was found to be a more effective and significantly less expensive alternative for labor induction compared to the combination of dinoprostone and oxytocin.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was lower in the misoprostol group (21.62%) compared to the dinoprostone and oxytocin group (37.14%), though this difference was not statistically significant.
